---
title: "4. Beta densities"
params:
  run_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setup.R", local = TRUE)
stages <- prepDNAm::qc_density_stages(rd)
labels <- c(raw = "Raw", noob = "After Noob background and dye-bias correction",
            bmiq = "After BMIQ probe-type normalisation (retained samples)")
nb <- length(rd$batches)
fig_h <- 3.5 * ceiling(nb / 3) + 1
```

Per-sample beta value densities at each processing stage. Good samples show two sharp peaks near 0 and 1; each sample has its own colour and removed samples are dashed. Hover over a curve to see the sample; drag to zoom, double-click to reset.

```{r, results="asis"}
if (length(stages) == 0) not_available("Density data")
```

```{r, results="asis"}
for (s in stages) {
  cat("\n\n## ", labels[[s]], "\n\n", sep = "")
  p <- prepDNAm::qc_plot_densities(rd, stage = s, n_points = 128)
  emit_widget(interactive_plot(p, height = round(90 * fig_h)))
}
```
